title: Taylor Swift to perform at the CMA Awards for the first time in 13 years
summary: The singer returns to country music's biggest night in Nashville next Wednesday.
body:
Taylor Swift will perform at the 60th CMA Awards next week, the Country Music Association and ABC announced today.

It will be her first performance at the ceremony since 2013, when she sang "Red" with Vince Gill and Alison Krauss. The show takes place at Bridgestone Arena in Nashville on Wednesday 18 November and will be broadcast live on ABC and Disney+.

Nominated again

Swift is nominated for Single of the Year for "I Knew It, I Knew You", her song from the film Toy Story 5. It is her 26th CMA nomination.

Organisers have not said which song she will perform.

Sources: Rolling Stone, Billboard, Deadline.
